description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin dialog for the 'scaytcheck' feature, including UI elements for options, languages, dictionaries, and about info, as well as functions for handling user interactions and dictionary management.

methods.name: getBOMAllOptions
methods.description: Returns the options form element from the options bar.

methods.name: getBOMAllLangs
methods.description: Returns the language selection form element from the languages bar.

methods.name: setCheckedValue
methods.description: Sets the checked state of a radio button group based on a new value.

methods.name: init_with_captions
methods.description: Initializes dialog UI elements with localized captions and sets up event handlers.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads dialog state, options, language selection, and user dictionary info.

methods.name: dic_error_message
methods.description: Displays an error message related to dictionary operations.

methods.name: dic_success_message
methods.description: Displays a success message related to dictionary operations.

methods.name: set_dic_name
methods.description: Sets the value of the dictionary name input field.
